name: OWLv2
license_interpretation: Apache-2.0 is a permissive license, so these checkpoints can be used in commercial and closed-source products. It asks you to keep the license text and attribution notices with any copy of the weights you redistribute, and it grants a patent license. LibreYOLO vendors no OWLv2 model source of its own: LibreOWLv2 calls the Apache-2.0 `transformers` implementation, `Owlv2ForObjectDetection`, directly, and downloads the official checkpoints into a LibreYOLO-hosted mirror repository that preserves the upstream snapshot files.
bibtex_verified: 2026-08-08, copied verbatim from the OWL-ViT v2 entry in the References section of the upstream README on branch main (the same file separately carries an OWL-ViT v1 entry, arXiv 2205.06230, not used here since LibreOWLv2 wraps only v2). Cross-checked against the arXiv API for 2306.09683: three authors, same order, same title, no journal-ref recorded in the arXiv metadata, matching the NeurIPS 2023 form the README already gives. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.
